# TURTLE

<img src="./.assets/logo.png" alt="drawing" style="height:150px;">

> **T**rusted **U**biquitous **R**elay for **T**ransport **L**ayer **E**xchange

## Road Map

- [x] Support for authentication messages
- [x] Support for data messages
- [x] Support for basic protocol over arbitrary transport (e.g. using `net.Listener` and `net.Conn`)
- [x] Initial performance test
- [x] Support for control messages
- [x] Support for serving/connecting over a WebSocket (required for source IP preservation, web based clients, etc)
- [x] Support for meshing relays
- [x] CI/CD
- [x] Support for use in WASM
- [ ] Support for server key verification (allowlist)
